ms.report:
Proof of Achievement Report
M2: UI Enhancement and Redesign Milestone - RWA Tokenisation
Summary
This milestone successfully delivered the redesign and improvement of the first iterated RWA tokenisation template system, transforming it from a proof-of-concept implementation into a production-ready feature fully integrated within NMKR Studio. The enhanced system now enables users to issue Real World Assets via an intuitive template selection interface with comprehensive metadata fields tailored to specific RWA use cases.
Milestone Outputs Delivered
Identify Areas for Enhancement
Through comprehensive analysis of the M1 implementation and research of RWA projects launched on NMKR Studio, we identified key areas requiring improvement:
・Template metadata fields lacked real-world applicability
・User interface was limited to non-public reference implementation
・Missing preview functionality hindered template selection
・Backend integration was incomplete for production use
・Documentation was insufficient for user adoption

Update Design and Functionality
Major Design Updates:
・Full NMKR Studio Integration: Migrated from standalone proof-of-concept to complete UI integration
・Metadata Preview System: Implemented template preview functionality accessible via button on each template, which improved user flow for template discovery and selection
・Production-Ready Styling:Slightly enhanced visual design and user experience elements

Functionality Enhancements:
・Backend Communication Layer: Developed robust backend integration ensuring seamless communication between template system and project creation
・NFT Minting Integration: Multiple different templates are now fully functional during the minting process for the assets in a project, with possibility for specific customization of single assets
・Template Accessibility: Guaranteed template availability throughout the project lifecycle, can be accessed via Edit Project.

Test and Iterate Based on Internal Feedback

ms.report:
Dear reviewers,
Please find the Milestone 5 Proof of Achievement for proposal 1100243 (Real World Asset Tokenization Minting Capabilities in NMKR Studio).
The report covers all five required acceptance criteria: 
Review of Implementation (Section 2), Functionality Assessment (Section 3), Performance Analysis (Section 4), Challenges and Resolutions (Section 5), and Lessons Learned (Section 6).

Key highlights:
- Two certified diamonds tokenized as full-ownership RWA NFTs using the Gemstone template
- Both assets publicly launched with direct purchase links
- Platform documentation updated
- No scope deviations; all deliverables completed on schedule

Full report:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1WSi8jKhe_i7zYHkKahxMF9RVeXZ_fpV57z376diX758/edit?usp=sharing

Supporting evidence (also listed in Section 7 of the report):
- Documentation: https://docs.nmkr.io/nmkr-studio/project/create/create-templated-projects
- Public launch: https://x.com/nmkr_io/status/2014742550901354834 / https://x.com/nmkr_io/status/2015739744030691481
- M4 Video Demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TUIZVGFXwxU

Note: The diamond RWAs are mint-ready in NMKR Studio and will appear on-chain under Policy ID 68080e0f5a63f253cd98d8108c2a3d3620177d6d36daa4b7abfe6c40 once the first sale occurs.

Edit for Reviewer:
The NFTs have a certificate of ownership alongside the GIA certifications of authenticity. The physical item can be claimed at LCX, which we are partners with and that act as a legal and insured custodian. Please check all the details here in our docs: https://docs.nmkr.io/nmkr-playground/how-to-claim-your-diamond

Thank you
